notes.title: Border Bots VR is Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Border Bots VR is Out Now on SteamVR![/h2]
Light-hearted VR puzzle job-sim game, Border Bots VR has just launched for SteamVR! Immerse yourself in a futuristic megacity, operate a border checkpoint and meet a variety of quirky robots.

[previewyoutube=Nfb4op8R2y0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]⛽ ENTER A ROBOT FUELLED FUTURE[/h3]
Border Bots VR tasks players with managing the flow of robots into the city after an incident sees them mysteriously malfunctioning... Get to the bottom of it, Number One!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/45f7d015832391969c8e83c2f0e6aeef7f49dcab.gif[/img]
[h3]✅ OPERATE THE BORDERS[/h3]
Check documents for discrepancies and robots for unauthorised modifications while confiscating forbidden items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/9d4a6e46e5b3996ad99ecddbb98c628fd7b75a05.gif[/img]
[h3]🖨️ UTILISE QUIRKY GADGETS[/h3]
Ensure a hard day’s work with an array of handy gadgets such as a 3D Printer, Barcode Scanner, and Contraband Detector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/c46a8e1d74b214f53fd9ed74b4a7308d26fe7541.gif[/img]
[h3]🤖 MEET MECHANICAL FRIENDS[/h3]
Interact with a host of friendly assistant AI and mechanical denizens, ensuring they have the necessary clearance to enter the city, and aren’t concealing any unauthorised items. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/0a51c704111114907f58343f8e5027be9478405e.gif[/img]
[h3]🪜 RISE UP THE LADDER[/h3]
Rise up the corporate ladder by purchasing upgrades, gadgets, and booth enhancements, and keep an eye on the competition with performance review leaderboards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/3f8a5a65731ff9308b0dfbb597e5e20fb732efcf.gif[/img]
[h2]Happy Launch Day! 🥳[/h2]
We are so excited to see you play Border Bots VR, interacting with our quirky robots and can't wait to read your thoughts about our VR game!

If you enjoy Border Bots VR, consider [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/874440/reviews/]leaving a Steam review here.[/url]
[h2]Support[/h2]
If you do run into any bugs in Border Bots VR, please get in contact with our [url=https://www.team17.com/support/]Support Team here.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/970690ccd79350668e68a7ecf9413389c8560d96.gif[/img]

That's all for today folks! 👋

[previewyoutube=cVY_g_hRa5w;full][/previewyoutube][h3]Border Bots VR releases on 8th February for SteamVR! [/h3]
Ready to transport yourself into a robot-led future? Border Bots VR tasks players with managing the flow of robots into the city after an incident sees them mysteriously malfunctioning, placing them into the boots of a human border agent stationed within a futuristic megacity. [b]Utilise:[/b] Ensure a hard day’s work with an array of handy gadgets such as a 3D Printer, Barcode Scanner, and Contraband Detector 

[b]Corporatise:[/b] Rise up the corporate ladder by purchasing upgrades, gadgets, and booth enhancements, and keep an eye on the competition with performance review leaderboards.

notes.title: Meet Dusty! 👋 I Border Bots VR
notes.content:
Hey all! Today we have our second robot highlight for Border Bots VR:
[h3]Meet Dusty! 👋[/h3]
Only one robot will keep your apartment clean, so meet your companion Dusty- a vacuum robot! Dusty is one of the first companions you'll meet in Border Bots VR after your required and well-needed apartment upgrade. Interact with this vacuum robot on a daily basis for some unique tasks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/1ccd3e692c2c25863623bcde93e1e598a558e93c.png[/img][h3]Dirt and grime![/h3]
Dusty enjoys sucking up dirt, metal shards and cubes whilst keeping your apartment clean in the process. Dusty's self-written song tells you everything you need to know about them: 🎵 "Sucking up the dirt, sucking up the grime, sucking up anything I find!" 🎵

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/c22d43f756aa21ec4400b0fb87b1dde54da197eb.gif[/img]
[h3]The lack of dust is freaky...[/h3]
It's in their name- if Dusty doesn't get enough dust, they'll begin to freak! For Dusty- dirt is good, grime is  tastier, but dust is the best of the lot! 😋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/78a44d26c1c486f8d57c76318bc567412196ceab.gif[/img]
[h3]Skin flakes... yummy![/h3]
In conversations, Dusty will let you know what they've discovered and vacuumed up around your apartment. I promise Dusty is worth interacting with, even if they do discuss how great their breakfast of skin flakes was... 🤢

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/06c8304fc3ca7484dbbcb50ac6aefc9d154041b7.gif[/img]
[h2]In Case You Missed it[/h2]
Border Bots VR is a lighthearted single-player puzzle job-simulator set on a future earth where AI is in control. As a human border agent, you begin a new role as a booth operator at an AI travel border. Interact and check over a variety of robots as they try to get through security. Some of their credentials might not be up to scratch, it's up to you to make sure they get the stamp of approval.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/0b8254539a66e2b767a95b28a4f2621c1ec8bbe2.jpg[/img]
Our [b]release date of 8th February[/b] 2024 is not far away for SteamVR! [b]Wishlist Border Bots VR today 👇[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/874440/Border_Bots_VR/

That's all... for now! 👋

notes.title: Meet Burnie! 👋 I Border Bots VR
notes.content:
Hey all! Today we have our very first robot highlight for Border Bots VR:
[h3]Meet Burnie! 👋[/h3]
Burnie is a robot who's here for all your toasting needs. You meet Burnie in your apartment in the early days of Border Bots VR. Make sure you interact daily with this iconic robot! 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/49a863d7f753300144208f80a34070617ae66858.gif[/img]
[h3]Questioning purpose[/h3]
Burnie asks the real questions and not just about bread! When interacting with this robot around your apartment in Border Bots VR, you'll find out he's questioning his purpose if he's not toasting things. So give Burnie a helping hand by finding items to toast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/847c8d3041361e0d8f97c1bd4b3e76d25a1a36d0.gif[/img]
[h3]Practise Toasting[/h3]
This robot needs to practise their talents and you are the key to this! If Burnie isn't toasting, how will he get his 10,000 hours in? Without this, there's no chance they can become an expert in their field. Don't leave him alone, that'd be crummy of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/4cdfbf6ec876c1ac69f6758741e4fc90667c3a2a.gif[/img]

There are many ways to interact with this engaging robot in your apartment. Burnie's toasting needs don't stop at bread... but we will let you all explore this for yourselves in February! 👀

notes.title: Border Bots VR moves to February 8th 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/86a79d590de1bfc11ba50dcab8cba351b5da5f64.jpg[/img]

We’ve made the decision to move the release date for Border Bots VR to 8th February 2024.

This is to ensure the game launches simultaneously on all our planned VR platforms, so that all our players can experience the game at the same time.

We apologise for any disappointment and look forward to sharing the game with everyone when it releases early next year.

notes.title: Border Bots VR I Coming September 28th to SteamVR!
notes.content:
[h2]First gameplay revealed for Border Bots VR![/h2]

Today we have exciting news as we are thrilled to showcase the first gameplay footage for Border Bots VR, our single-player VR puzzle-simulator game!

[previewyoutube=giswWE5jT_8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]In case you missed it...[/h3]
Team17 and Paw Print Games in association with vTime Games, announced Border Bots VR in August, a single-player VR simulation-puzzle game. We are also delighted to reveal the release date of Border Bots VR today!

[h2]Border Bots VR is coming to SteamVR on 28th September![/h2]

We hope you are excited to explore a futuristic mega-city, whilst operating a robot border checkpoint and carefully controlling robot travel. Robots have started ignoring their instructions! Can you get to the bottom of this issue, Number One?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/0b8254539a66e2b767a95b28a4f2621c1ec8bbe2.jpg[/img]
[h3]Border Bots VR Gameplay: [/h3]
[b]ANALYSE DOCUMENTS[/b]
Step into the booth as a border control agent and swiftly process robots by analysing their documents for discrepancies, oddities, undeclared modifications and contraband! 

[b]UPGRADE[/b]
Earn credits through challenging gameplay to purchase booth upgrades to keep yourself ahead of the competition. You can also spend your credits on apartment customisations and bring your space to life! 

[b]QUIRKY ROBOTS [/b]
Meet and interact with a variety of quirky robots at the booth and in your apartment! Come face-to-face with sentient appliances as you discover more about their newfound consciousness and colourful personalities. 

[b]VARIETY OF GADGETS[/b]
Use a variety of tactile gadgets in VR to examine robots at the booth. You'll need different tools for inspection including a 3D printer, Contraband Detector, Stun Gun, Barcode Scanner and much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32895532/eaf6fca22fb5842e09a0add0d2d2ddaebeb3feab.jpg[/img]
That's all... for now! 👋
